entities.summary: Brandon Grae Dubinsky is an American former professional ice hockey player. He previously played for the New York Rangers and Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). Dubinsky was drafted 60th overall in the 2004 NHL entry draft by the Rangers.
